en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。
features.placeholder:
FOO=bar
BAR=$FOO
-UNWANTED_VAR
# 注释行与空行忽略

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

features.description: 与收藏/命令联想独立的开关：输入词命中应用清单（工具条动作/面板/管理入口/功能开关）时在联想弹窗尾部追加「应用」候选，点击或 ↑↓/Tab 选中后回车直接执行，不向输入框插入文本。→ 自动接受会跳过应用候选（防误执行）。

features.label: 短输入严格过滤阈值（字符数，超过才宽松匹配）
features.description: 查询长度 ≤ 该值时走严格过滤：英文≥3字符/中文≥2字，且查询需达标题或内容长度的 1/4 才弹出（防短词命中长正文噪音）；> 该值按 substring 宽松匹配。0=关闭严格过滤。

features.label: suggest 命令 ⚡ 一键执行（候选项旁加执行按钮，危险命令二次确认）
features.description: 开启后命令联想候选项旁出现 ⚡：点击直接执行该命令（走 aiti-cmd /run + 两段式确认；不自动触发）。

features.label: 语音与高速输入拼写修复（识别到语音或高速输入后修复错字/代码词音译）
语音/高速输入感知条（识别到语音或高速输入时顶部提示正在修复）
实时识别（按住麦克风边说边出；SenseVoice 伪实时分句秒出 / paraformer WS）
features.description: 实时识别开。流式模型选 SenseVoice（默认）= VAD 停顿分句 + SenseVoice 秒出逐句上屏（快，纯中文好）；选 paraformer = 老 WS 逐 chunk 实时（质量差）。

features.label: VAD 自动切句（说话停顿自动切句识别）
features.description: 按住 🎤 说话，停顿约 0.7s 自动切句并识别上屏；不需要时可关。

features.label: 静音判定阈值（RMS，越小越灵敏）
features.description: 本地 VAD 切句的静音判据：某帧 RMS 低于该值即算静音。实测参考：正常说话 RMS≈0.02~0.10，小声/离麦远≈0.010，很低声≈0.003，安静房间底噪≈0.002~0.003。默认 0.005：够灵敏又高于底噪；安静环境可 0.003，嘈杂/键盘声多改 0.01~0.02。只影响「本地切句」链路（云引擎 + 伪实时分句），走服务端 /ws/vad 时由服务端判定。

features.label: 麦克风输入增益（倍）
features.description: 1–8 倍，只作用于送识别的音频（不写入录音文件，不改系统音量）。小声说话可设 2–4；过大会削波失真，>8 无效。

features.label: 伪实时分句（按住麦克风说话停顿自动切句，SenseVoice 秒出逐句上屏，松手收尾）
features.description: 按住说话，停顿 ~0.7s 自动把该句发 SenseVoice 识别上屏（~0.3s/句），不用松手等整段；松手提交尾句。SenseVoice 纯中文快，术语/英文会拆字母。

features.label: 语音二次识别（松手后稍延离线精修再上屏，2-pass 更准）
实时流式模型
features.description: 实时识别模型：SenseVoice（默认·伪实时分句·快）或 paraformer-zh-streaming（老 WS chunk 流式）；改后服务重启生效。

features.label: 2-pass 精修模型
features.description: 松手后离线精修模型（标点/术语大小写/语种；Qwen3 带 context 热词）; 改后服务重启生效。

Empty = read-only subset (messages / page reads / human-in-the-loop; write-class tools such as page_exec and form_fill are withheld — G1 secure default). * = everything (restores the old behavior, including page execution and form writes). extensions.name: Claude Code (resume)

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.

extensions.description: Drives Claude Code CLI sessions — restores history rows from All Sessions (agentKey: claude); claude 2.1.318+ keyring credentials with a three-tier login-state adjudication

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。
features.placeholder:
FOO=bar
BAR=$FOO
-UNWANTED_VAR
# 注释行与空行忽略

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

en.cmd.k346: The virtual keyboard has two tiers, "⌨ Frequent / ABC full": Frequent = arrows/editing/Ctrl combos; full = complete letters/digits/symbols keyboard (with space, so you can type full commands). The four locks CTRL/SHIFT/ALT/WIN latch on one tap and auto-unlock on the next key (same feel as a physical keyboard): CTRL lock + letter = Ctrl+letter (a→Ctrl+A for line start), + arrow = word-wise move (readline); SHIFT lock + letter = uppercase (needed for grep -E), + digit = shifted symbol, + arrow = Shift+arrow (selection); ALT/WIN lock + letter/symbol = ESC prefix (Meta key), + arrow = Alt+arrow (xterm [1;3x sequences, so programs can tell Alt is held). Note: the terminal escape protocol can't tell left/right Shift/Alt apart (only GUI programs can), so there is a single SHIFT/ALT lock. While the terminal is focused: Ctrl+Shift+F fullscreen, Ctrl+Shift+K keyboard, Ctrl+Shift+S cycle window size.

extensions.description: Command manager — real PTY terminal + favorite commands + message-click recognition execution + live agent command observation + a unified cross-extension execution outlet

features.label: agent 工具：aiti_cmd_run（AI 会话内经后端 runner 执行命令；危险命令二次确认）
features.description: 关闭后新 agent 会话不再注入该工具（已注入会话即时拒绝）。

extensions.name: CodeBuddy Code (腾讯)

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.
en.feat.codebuddy.packageSpec.desc: Package pulled by the npx fallback (default @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code latest cache; pin a version supported by the local Node)
en.feat.codebuddy.model.desc: Default model id for new sessions (--model): default-model/fast-model/balanced-model family aliases or a full model id
en.feat.codebuddy.permissionMode.desc: --permission-mode: default/acceptEdits/bypassPermissions (maps to the agent tool's permission semantics)
en.feat.codebuddy.connectionMode.desc: stream (default, long-lived connection: single process, multi-turn, cwd switching saves cold start) | oneshot (single-shot process per turn, legacy fallback)
en.feat.codebuddy.apiKey.desc: CODEBUDDY_API_KEY: personal API key from the Tencent CodeBuddy platform (used by the npx fallback)
en.feat.codebuddy.authToken.desc: CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN: existing OAuth token (preferred by the CLI side; for logged-in desktop users)
en.feat.codebuddy.baseUrl.desc: CODEBUDDY_BASE_URL: point to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (bypassing the Tencent gateway, e.g. a self-hosted proxy)
en.feat.codebuddy.bridgeUrl.desc: AITI_BRIDGE_URL: enables aiti_* tools inside cbc sessions connecting to the AITI bridge (MCP tool injection)
en.feat.codebuddy.cliPath.desc: Path to the cbc executable (absolute path after npm i -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code or brew install codebuddy-code). Empty = auto-detect cbc/codebuddy on PATH → npx fallback (first use downloads).

extensions.description: Tencent CodeBuddy Code CLI (cbc) driver — stream long connection (default) + exec fallback dual mode + --resume into All Sessions, control_request three channels, API-key env login

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。
features.placeholder:
FOO=bar
BAR=$FOO
-UNWANTED_VAR
# 注释行与空行忽略

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

features.label: CLI 路径
features.description: 指定 cbc 可执行文件（npm i -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 或 brew install codebuddy-code 后的绝对路径）。留空自动探测 PATH 上的 cbc/codebuddy → npx 兜底（首用有下载延迟）。

features.label: npx 包 spec
features.description: npx 兜底通道拉的包（默认 @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 最新缓存；可钉版本如 @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code@2.148.0）。仅 cliPath 未配置时生效。

features.label: 默认模型
features.description: 新会话默认模型 id（--model）：default-model/fast-model/balanced-model/primary-model/deep-model/glm-5.3/glm-5.2/kimi-k3/kimi-k2.6/minimax-m3/gemini-3.5-flash/gpt-5.x…。留空用账号默认档。

features.label: 权限模式
features.description: --permission-mode：default/acceptEdits/bypassPermissions/plan/dontAsk/auto。默认 bypassPermissions（headless 无审批面，未放行=任务失败）。stream 模式支持运行中 control_request 切换，exec 模式下轮 spawn 生效。

features.label: 连接模式
features.description: stream（默认，长连接：单进程多轮、cwd 进程内固定、免每轮冷启动、运行中可切模型/权限）| exec（兼容档：每轮单发 + --resume，进程隔离）。改后对已有会话需 /session/recycle 或重新打开生效。

features.label: API Key（凭据）
features.description: CODEBUDDY_API_KEY：腾讯 CodeBuddy 平台个人 API key（覆盖凭据文件）。第三方 OpenAI 兼容网关请同时配 baseUrl。改后即刻生效（下轮 spawn 注入）。

features.label: Auth Token（凭据）
features.description: CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN：已有 OAuth token（CLI 侧优先级高于 API key）。一般留空。

features.label: Base URL（第三方模型网关）

features.label: AITI 桥 URL（MCP 工具注入）

extensions.name: Codex CLI

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.

en.feat.trace.enabled.desc: When on, AI session file changes are written into the .aiti-trace tracking repo (off by default)
en.feat.trace.excludeExtra.desc: Extra excludes on top of the built-in list (stacks with the project .gitignore)
en.feat.trace.includeExtra.desc: ! patterns to rescue paths wrongly hit by built-in excludes (parent dirs need negating too)
en.feat.trace.builtinExcludes.desc: When off, only the project gitignore + user extra excludes remain
en.feat.trace.maxFileKB.desc: Files above this size don't enter the tracking repo; the ledger logs skipped
en.feat.trace.scope.desc: repo=work-tree as repo root (cross-boundary within the same repo allowed); cwd=huge repos are constrained to the current cwd subtree
en.feat.trace.autoInit.desc: Auto-creates the .aiti-trace repo within the file budget when no git directory exists
en.feat.trace.autoInitMaxFiles.desc: Skips auto-init above this file count (prevents build-artifact flooding)
en.feat.trace.autoInitSeedIgnores.desc: Loose init also seeds common ignores like node_modules/
en.feat.trace.watchUI.desc: Shows a standalone "⎇ Watched paths" button in the toolbar (default off — entry lives in the timeline panel)
en.feat.trace.timelineUI.desc: Shows a standalone "⎇ Timeline" button in the toolbar (default on — main entry in the input box toolbar)

en.gt.watch.app.title: aiti-git-trace: watch-path management (workspace-persistent + per-session; git repos only)

en.gt.watch.traceOff: Tracking fully disabled for this workspace (stops before the next op).
en.gt.watch.traceOffHint: Disable for very large repos if tracking overhead hurts AI responsiveness. Re-enable anytime.
en.gt.watch.experimental: Experimental: tracking records file changes on a best-effort basis and does NOT guarantee every file is captured (exclude rules, size limits, permissions, etc. are skipped).
en.gt.watch.title: Watch paths
en.gt.watch.nogit: No git repo and auto-init is off (or system dir / over budget) — NOT tracked. Watch paths pointing at git repos still work.
en.gt.watch.loose: No git repo here — will auto-create .aiti-trace lightweight tracking (small dir).
en.gt.watch.oversize: No git repo, and this dir exceeds the file budget — lightweight tracking skipped (trace.autoInitMaxFiles).
en.gt.watch.denied: No git repo, and this is a system/home dir — lightweight tracking skipped.
en.gt.timeline.title: Ops timeline
en.gt.timeline.treeEmpty: No fork lineage (this session is not a fork and has no children).
en.gt.timeline.treeTip: Click a session to view its timeline.
en.gt.tl.cleanAll: This will DELETE the entire session ledger (irreversible).
en.gt.tl.cleanBefore: This will DELETE ledger entries before op #{n} (op #{n} onwards is kept).
en.gt.tl.cleanBeforeTip: Clean ledger entries before this op (keep this one onwards)
en.gt.watch.sessionRepos: Git repos recognized in this session
en.gt.watch.pinTip: Add to workspace watch paths (persists across sessions)
en.gt.watch.needCwd: No workspace context on this page — type a cwd and resolve.
en.gt.watch.cleanupConfirm: Delete ALL session ledgers + reset the trace store for this workspace?
en.gt.watch.cleanupTip: Clears tracking data only: deletes all session ledgers under this workspace and resets the trace store (running sessions auto-rebuild an empty store). Cleared trace history can't be recovered. Files and code in your working path are completely unaffected.
en.gt.timeline.reviewGroup: Review this prompt (all ops in the group)
en.gt.timeline.reviewSelTip: Range = first to last selected group (consecutive groups in between included)
en.gt.timeline.selGroup: Select this prompt for range review
en.gt.timeline.empty: No ops recorded for this session.
en.gt.timeline.fileDiffTip: File deleted — open the deletion diff in review
en.gt.timeline.atRefTip: Mention in current session input (@ path, not sent)
en.gt.timeline.atNewTip: New session with pre-filled mention (cwd aligned to file repo)
en.gt.tl.rowMention: @ this line to new session (with version)
en.gt.timeline.confirm: Rollback worktree to the state before this op?
en.gt.timeline.partialHint: This op is a first-touch (no before baseline) and cannot be reverse-applied; its after commit is the earliest restorable point.
en.gt.timeline.viewTip: Switch grouping: by user message / by file
en.gt.timeline.fileExpand: Show the ops that touched this file
en.gt.timeline.fileEmpty: No file-level changes (baseline-only snapshots are not counted)
en.gt.timeline.truncTip: Only the first 50 changed paths per op are listed (the ±N count is complete)
en.gt.fork.title: AI changes — what to do?
en.gt.fork.desc: Edit-from-here will retract the message turns below and resend them. The AI changed files during those turns — choose how to handle those file changes:
en.gt.fork.rollbackHint: Undo the file changes made in those turns, restoring files to their state before them
en.gt.fork.keepHint: Keep the file changes; only the edited message is resent
en.gt.fork.cancelHint: Discard this edit; the conversation stays untouched
en.gt.fork.skippedHint: Rolled back; {n} op(s) without baseline were skipped and kept.
en.gt.fork.failTitle: Rollback failed midway; some changes not reverted
en.gt.fork.failHint: "Let AI handle" pastes the full scene into the AI input; "Ignore" keeps current state.
en.gt.fork.viewFileTip: Click to view this file's changes in the timeline panel
en.gt.fork.peeking: Reviewing file changes — decision on hold
en.gt.fork.expandTip: Click to expand the full decision dialog
en.gt.fork.gapTip: First tracked op in this repo (no before baseline) — its changes cannot be auto-reverted and will be kept.
en.gt.timeline.viewTip2: Switch view: overview / by operation / lineage
en.gt.ov.netNote: Line counts are net range diffs and may include other edits to the same files.
en.gt.ov.noMatch: No files match the current filters.
en.gt.ov.noFiles: No file changes in this range.
en.gt.ov.storeMissing: Trace store missing for this session's repos — nothing to summarize.
en.gt.ov.filesTruncated: More than 2000 changed files; showing the first 2000.
en.gt.footer.title: File changes traced by git-trace beyond the write/edit list ({n} traced ops). Click a file to view its diff in the timeline.
en.gt.footer.truncated: Some changed files are not listed (ledger path cap).

extensions.description: Out-of-band AI change tracking — repo-root .aiti-trace standalone trace repo (autoInit even without git) + op-numbered before/after dual commits + full file⇄message⇄op lineage + rollback + shadow repo slimming compact

extensions.name: Oh My Pi (omp 子进程后端)

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.
en.feat.hostToolsAllow.desc: Allowlist of bridge (aiti_*) tools injected into the agent. Empty = read-only subset (messages / page reads / human-in-the-loop; write-class tools such as page_exec and form_fill are withheld — G1 secure default). * = everything (restores the old behavior, including page execution and form writes). A precise list also works (comma/space separated, e.g. aiti_inbox, page_exec). Tools outside the list make the agent's call fail with unknown host tool; takes effect on the next session.

extensions.description: Oh My Pi (omp.sh) — RPC spawn backend for pi's largest fork (split from aiti-pi-agent to specialize in omp): `omp --mode rpc` child process + ready handshake / get_state capability surface / host tools / login / branch

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。
features.placeholder:
FOO=bar
BAR=$FOO
-UNWANTED_VAR
# 注释行与空行忽略

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

features.label: 桥工具白名单
features.description: 注入 agent 的桥（aiti_*）工具白名单。留空 = 只读子集（消息/页面读/人机交互类；page_exec、form_fill 等写类不注入——G1 安全缺省）。* = 全量（恢复旧现状，含页面执行/表单写）。也可给精确名单（逗号/空格分隔，如 aiti_inbox, page_exec）。名单外工具 agent 调用会报 unknown host tool；改完下一轮会话生效。
features.placeholder: 留空=只读子集；*=全量；或 aiti_inbox, page_snapshot, page_exec

extensions.name: Qoder CLI (国际/CN 独立 CLI·非 IDE)

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.

extensions.description: Exclusive Qoder CLI session backend (qodercli/qoderclicn): credits/quota (getUsage), WASM-signed model catalog (listModels), task-list mirror, run-queue management, and plan/permission-mode support.

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

en.ext.description: Virtual display with x11vnc + node vnc-bridge/noVNC — view/operate the virtual desktop from the browser
en.feat.agentTools.enabled.desc: Injects ui_env_* tools into sessions (off by default; enable temporarily via the AI helper 🤖 or the extension manager)
en.feat.behavior.atspi.desc: Injects GTK/Qt a11y switches into the virtual display environment (semantic tree visible, for assistive/AI reading)
en.feat.behavior.autostart-headless: Auto-start the virtual display when not running
en.feat.behavior.autostart-headless.desc: resolve/run auto-starts Xvfb when the virtual display isn't running
en.feat.behavior.random-display.desc: Auto-picks a free DISPLAY number for the virtual display (auto random avoidance, avoids conflicts with the local :0)
en.feat.behavior.wm.desc: WM for the headless virtual display (EWMH-verified whitelist: openbox/xfwm4/fluxbox/icewm/jwm/metacity/pekwm/blackbox). If the value is unsupported, not installed or fails to start, the next installed one in that order is used automatically. Takes effect on the next virtual display start; the systemd service path needs a service reinstall
en.feat.behavior.display-num.desc: A non-empty number pins the virtual display to that DISPLAY number (avoids only real foreign occupancy); empty = auto random. Takes precedence over the random-avoidance toggle
en.feat.behavior.rdp.desc: webRDP: tunnels the RDP protocol to the browser via rdp-bridge over WebSocket (requires xrdp on this machine)
en.feat.behavior.vnc.desc: Virtual display with x11vnc + node vnc-bridge/noVNC — view/operate the virtual desktop from the browser
en.feat.behavior.audio.desc: Injects PULSE_SERVER + PIPEWIRE_RUNTIME_DIR (auto-discovered from /run/user/<uid>) into GUI apps started for the virtual screen / desktop, so WebViews and players launched over SSH or by an agent have sound; off leaves audio variables untouched
en.feat.tool.ui_env_rdp.desc: Probes system RDP (xrdp), starts/stops the RDP-on-web bridge, returns browser links
en.feat.tool.ui_env_resolve.desc: Decides the target display by current mode, returns env-var JSON + probe info
en.feat.tool.ui_env_run.desc: Launches a command with the resolved environment (background), returns pid/log path
en.feat.tool.ui_env_set_mode.desc: Switches display mode (1 prefer desktop / 2 prefer headless / 3 always headless)
en.feat.tool.ui_env_status.desc: Reports current mode, desktop/virtual display probe, VNC links, dependency health
en.feat.tool.ui_env_vnc.desc: Queries/starts/stops VNC-on-web (browser view of the virtual desktop)
en.it.ui-env-dialog.label: Display environment manager

en.mode.always-headless.desc: Force the virtual display; show start instructions when it is not running

en.mode.prefer-headless.desc: Use the virtual display when available, otherwise the desktop

en.srv.rationale.prefer-headless-fallback: Prefer headless → fell back to the desktop

extensions.name: ZCode CLI

en.feat.spawn.env.desc: One per line, injected when the agent subprocess is spawned (parsed by us, no shell dependency; works on Windows too): KEY=VALUE sets (supports $VAR / ${VAR} references — the current effective value first, then the parent process env; undefined becomes empty); -NAME removes that variable (emergency escape: one line drops a bad variable that leaked in); # and blank lines are ignored. This can override the auto-injected AITI_BRIDGE_URL, or remove it entirely with -AITI_BRIDGE_URL. Takes effect on the next spawn.
en.feat.spawn.displayEnv.desc: Injects the display environment decided by aiti-ui-env (DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS etc.) into sessions spawned by this extension, so GUI programs and MCP inside new sessions land on the matching screen (viewable in the browser over VNC). Values: empty or auto = follow the display mode (inject when a snapshot exists); off = never; headless = virtual-screen snapshots only; desktop = real-desktop snapshots only. Takes effect on the next spawn; same-named variables in spawn.env still override (e.g. DISPLAY=:0) or can be excluded with -DISPLAY.
en.feat.spawn.command.desc: Empty = use this extension's default CLI. When set, it replaces the default CLI command (docker wrapper: put docker here and use "spawn argument prefix" for run --rm -i … image CLI). Supports $VAR / ${cwd} references (expanded at spawn). Takes effect on the next spawn. Note: the command can run any local program, so only the machine owner should configure it (same trust level as spawn.env).
en.feat.spawn.argsPrefix.desc: One argument per line, prepended before the driver's built-in arguments (docker: run / --rm / -i / -v mount / image name / CLI inside the container). Supports $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd} (session working directory) references, expanded at spawn; # and blank lines are ignored. Takes effect on the next spawn. The docker recipe needs -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} so in-container paths match the host history.
en.feat.zcode.runtimePath.desc: ZCode runtime: zcode.cjs file, extracted dir, or executable; auto-probed when empty
en.feat.zcode.autoDownload.desc: Auto-downloads from the official site when the runtime isn't found (~30MB, cached)
en.feat.zcode.mode.desc: --mode for each spawn: build (asks on tool calls) / edit / plan
en.feat.zcode.model.desc: Default model for new sessions (provider/model, e.g. bigmodel/GLM-5.3)
en.feat.zcode.apiKeyOverride.desc: Manually provides the coding-plan API key (skips desktop keychain reuse)
en.feat.zcode.ultraGateway.desc: app-server routes dynamically via the zcode.z.ai platform root (desktop-linked accounts)
en.feat.zcode.transport.desc: app-server = long-lived ZCode Protocol (same as desktop: streaming typewriter/tool cards/native steer/hot model switch, saves ~5-6s cold start per turn); oneshot = single-shot process per turn (legacy fallback). Empty defaults to app-server.

extensions.description: Driven by Zhipu ZCode (CLI runtime embedded in the desktop AppImage) — dual-channel resident app-server (default, streaming/tool cards/steer/attachments) + oneshot fallback, plugged into All Sessions, consuming the GLM coding plan compliantly

features.label: 传输通道
features.description: app-server = 长驻 ZCode Protocol（桌面端同款：流式打字机/工具卡/原生 steer/热切模型，省每轮 ~5-6s 冷启动）；oneshot = 每轮单发进程（旧路径兜底）。留空默认 app-server。

features.label: Runtime 路径
features.description: 指定 ZCode runtime：zcode.cjs 文件、解压目录、或 ZCode-*.AppImage 本体。留空则自动探测（Windows 安装目录 / 挂载实例 / ~/.zcode）→ 自动下载。

features.label: 权限模式
features.description: 每轮 spawn 的 --mode：build（工具调用询问）/ edit（自动允许文件编辑）/ plan（只读规划）/ yolo（跳过全部权限询问，最大权限）。默认 yolo（2026-09-06 应用户要求由 build 改）。

features.label: 默认模型 ref
features.description: 新会话默认模型（provider/model，如 bigmodel/GLM-5.3）。留空自动跟随已认证的套餐通道（bigmodel/zai）。
features.placeholder: 留空自动跟随套餐通道

features.label: API Key 手动覆盖

features.placeholder: 留空使用桌面端登录凭据

features.label: Ultra 网关路由
features.description: app-server 走 zcode.z.ai 平台根动态路由（桌面端同款）。注意：宿主对未声明布尔 feature 默认 true——本项必须显式声明才可控。3.17.2 独立 spawn 下网关持续 server_error（2026-11-07 实测），默认直连 open.bigmodel.cn。

features.label: spawn 环境变量
features.description: 每行一条，启动 agent 子进程时注入（我们自行解析，不依赖 shell，Windows 同样可用）：KEY=VALUE 设置（支持 $VAR / ${VAR} 引用：先取当前生效值，再回退父进程环境变量；未定义按空串）；-NAME 移除该变量（急救口：透传漏进来的坏变量配一行即拔掉）；# 注释与空行忽略。此处可覆盖自动注入的 AITI_BRIDGE_URL，也可 -AITI_BRIDGE_URL 整个去掉。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。
features.placeholder:
FOO=bar
BAR=$FOO
-UNWANTED_VAR
# 注释行与空行忽略

features.label: 显示环境注入
features.description: 把 aiti-ui-env 显示模式裁决出的显示环境（DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY/DBUS 等）注入本扩展 spawn 的会话进程，新会话里的 GUI 程序与 MCP 即落在对应屏幕（虚拟屏可经浏览器 VNC 查看）。取值：留空或 auto = 跟随显示模式（快照存在即注入）；off = 不注入；headless = 仅虚拟屏快照注入；desktop = 仅真实桌面快照注入。改完下一轮 spawn 生效；spawn.env 里同名变量仍可覆盖（如 DISPLAY=:0）或 -DISPLAY 排除。

features.label: spawn 命令覆盖
features.description: 留空 = 使用本扩展默认 CLI。填入后以它替换默认 CLI 启动（docker 化包装：这里填 docker，再配「spawn 参数前缀」拼 run --rm -i … 镜像 CLI）。支持 $VAR / ${cwd} 引用（spawn 时展开）。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。注意：命令可执行任意本机程序，配置者须为本机管理员（与 spawn.env 同级信任）。

features.label: spawn 参数前缀
features.description: 每行一个参数，拼在驱动内置参数之前（docker 化：run / --rm / -i / -v 挂载 / 镜像名 / 容器内 CLI 名）。支持 $VAR / ${VAR} / ${cwd}（会话工作目录）引用，spawn 时展开；# 注释与空行忽略。改完下一轮 spawn 生效。docker 配方要求 -v ${cwd}:${cwd} -w ${cwd} 同路径挂载，否则容器内路径与宿主历史不一致。

en.services.allowToolDownloadHint: When disabled, only tools already installed on this machine are used; missing tools are not downloaded automatically.

en.services.userCheckUnavailable: Cannot verify auth users — refresh and retry
en.services.confirmNoUsersBody: No users under provider «{provider}» / site «{site}». Add one on the Users tab first (select the same provider and site), then expose again.
en.services.confirmUsersBody: The following accounts can sign in through this gateway (provider «{provider}» / site «{site}»). Make sure you hold the password of at least one of them — you'll need it to access the exposed service.
en.services.presetHint: Pick a saved preset to fill the whole form; the last-used options are auto-loaded when this opens
en.services.presetActionsEnrollHint: On apply: auto-enroll this port as an open vhost (with current Base Path)
en.services.presetActionsExposeHint: On apply: auto-expose using this scheme (auth confirm flow still applies)
en.services.presetActionsInjectHint: On apply: auto-enable currently checked injector sources
en.services.presetSaveAsHint: Save the current form choices as a named preset (secrets are encrypted on disk)
en.services.presetDeleteHint: Delete this preset (the form keeps its values)
en.services.injectJsEnableHint: When enabled, HTML served through this port's access channels (service vhost / tunnel) gets aiti-launcher.js injected automatically — the debugger appears in the page
en.services.injectJsBasePathHint: Prefix the service is actually served under (e.g. dev for vite base=/dev/): the vhost proxy strips the deploy prefix then re-attaches it. Empty = root
en.services.injectJsModeTunnel: tunnel mode: injection via nginx gateway (static snippet, main-page navigations)
en.services.injectJsUnavailable: aiti-devtools extension not loaded — injection management unavailable
en.services.injectJsSelfHint: When enabled, pi-web pages served via vhost/tunnel get the debugger injected (authenticated entries only; direct loopback access is not injected)
en.services.enrolledExtHint: Ports not in pi-web's process tree but enrolled as open vhosts via aiti injection (e.g. systemd/manual dev servers) — invisible to process scanning, yet actually exposed through the vhost proxy. Unenroll closes both the vhost proxy and injection (the service process itself is untouched)
en.services.enrolledBasePathHint: Service basePath: the vhost proxy strips the deploy prefix then re-attaches this prefix
en.services.enrolledUnenrollHint: Remove from injection enrollment: closes the vhost proxy (<port>.domain) and HTML injection together; the service process itself is untouched
en.services.extAddHint: Enroll a port not visible in pi-web's process tree (another machine, or a service started outside pi-web) — it becomes reachable via the vhost proxy; expanding its card probes the process and HTTP identity
en.services.extDetectHint: Probe this port: local process discovery + HTTP identity (title / favicon / protocol)
en.services.extDetectNone: No local process or HTTP service detected on this port
en.services.exposeDetailHint: Click a link to open it in a new tab; Stop only stops this channel
en.services.usersPickCombo: Users are maintained per site + auth combo. Click a row to manage that combination's users.
en.services.sitesManageHint: Each site is an independent auth realm (own provider and user db). Pick one when exposing; manage its users in the table below. Protected sites are built-in dependencies and cannot be removed.
en.services.sitesProtectedHint: Built-in protected site — the default realm / the self page's auth realm depends on it, cannot be removed
en.services.sitesRemoveHint: Remove this site (its user db and auth config go with it)
en.services.sitesRemoveConfirm: Remove site "{name}"? Its user db and auth config are removed with it. Active exposures keep running until stopped.
en.services.totpActivateHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator to activate — 2FA is NOT enforced until verified.
en.services.bioPortalNotRunning: Enrollment ticket issued, but the portal is not running — start an expose with this auth provider first, then reopen the capture page
en.services.bioFaceCaptureHint: Look at the camera and open your mouth once to capture each frame (3 frames). The template becomes active after your first successful face login.
en.services.bioFacePendingHint: Template saved — becomes active after your first successful face login
en.services.bioVoicePendingHint: Template saved — becomes active after your first successful voice login
en.services.bioFaceRerecordHint: Capture a new face template (replaces the current one)
en.services.bioFaceActiveHint: Face template is active — usable at login
en.services.loginInfoButtonHint: Inject a floating button on protected pages: shows the logged-in username and a logout button; draggable to screen edges
en.services.displayNameEditHint: Click to edit the display name (nickname)
en.services.bioFaceHint: 打开人脸采集页（浏览器摄像头；首次验证通过后模板转正）
en.services.bioVoiceHint: 打开语音采集页（3 轮数字朗读挑战）
en.services.noUsers: No users yet — add the first one below.
en.services.title: Service ports
en.services.selfExposeHint: Opens an authenticated public entry (portal/basic/authelia). External users reach pi-web only through this gateway; direct 127/LAN access is governed by the allowlocal switch below.
en.services.selfStopTunnelHint: Stop this tunnel channel (vhost entry stays)
en.services.selfStopVhostHint: Stop this vhost channel (removes the binding; tunnel entry stays)
en.services.selfAllowLocalHint: When OFF, LAN / public / loopback direct requests to this port are refused (403) — only the authenticated gateway works: virtual-host domains and self tunnel domains are routed through the proxy auth. Loopback (127.0.0.1/localhost) is affected too (only the gateway-authenticated self-exposure forward passes).
en.services.selfAllowHostsHint: Hostnames allowed to reach pi-web directly even when allowlocal=false — your own reverse-proxy fronts. Only the hosts you list here count (deployment domains are NOT auto-allowed: they must go through the proxy auth or be listed explicitly).
en.services.selfGatedHint: allowlocal=false: direct access is refused (403) — use the vhost/tunnel auth entry instead
en.services.selfNotExposingHint: pi-web is not exposed: with allowlocal=false, direct requests to this port (including loopback) are refused (403) — open an entry via an exposure method below (vhost / tunnel) first.
en.services.lockoutCountdown: Direct local access is temporarily disabled. It auto-restores in {ttl}s. Verify you can still reach pi-web (open an entry below to check login), then confirm within {window}s to keep it off permanently — otherwise it reverts automatically.
en.services.lockoutAutoRestore: No action → allowlocal auto-restores (nothing is locked).
en.services.lockoutBlockedHint: Direct access is now blocked (403) — this action needs an authenticated entry (vhost/tunnel). Waiting for auto-restore in ~{ttl}s, or use one of the reachable entries below.
en.services.lockoutNoEntry: There is no reachable entry while it is off: pi-web is not exposed (no vhost/tunnel) and no allowHost exception is configured. Turning it off would lock you out. Expose pi-web (vhost/tunnel auth entry) or add allowHost domains first.
en.services.lockoutRestored: allowlocal restored (true) — direct access works again
en.services.selfEnvHint: Permanent config — copy to your start script:
en.services.selfEnvNote: UI changes are one-shot; they reset on restart. Set PI_WEB_EXPOSE in the environment to persist.
en.services.selfWarning: pi-web is exposing while reachable at a non-loopback address — direct LAN access bypasses gateway auth. Prefer listening on 127.0.0.1 only, or keep a password set.
en.services.selfNoAuthSummary: anyone with the URL can fully control pi-web (run commands, read/write files) — data-leak risk
en.services.selfNoAuthBody: pi-web hosts agent sessions that can run arbitrary commands and read/write your files. The current self-exposure is NOT protected by any gateway auth (auth=none): anyone with the URL can fully control pi-web. Even with allowlocal off, open vhost/tunnel entries remain reachable via the deployment domain.
en.services.selfNoAuthSuggest: Switch to an authenticated expose method: in Services → Expose pi-web itself, change auth from none to portal / basic (or authelia) and make sure the site has a loggable user (2FA available)\nOr use proxy-only mode (local vhost, governed by the allowlocal / password gate), without a tunnel\nOr stop exposing now and re-configure later
en.services.none: No service ports found. Servers started by pi sessions appear here automatically.
en.services.infoAccess: How other devices reach these services (DNS / wildcard domain)
en.services.exposeLan: LAN: add "address=/pi.lan/<server-ip>" to dnsmasq, then set PI_WEB_SVC_HOST_SUFFIX=.pi.lan and PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS=pi.lan.
en.services.exposePublic: Public domain: wildcard A record *.pi.example.com → server IP, add the domain to PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
en.services.exposeTunnel: Tunnels expose ONE service port (or its virtual-host subdomain) — never pi-web itself. Pick a tunnel type + auth provider in the port card's “Public access” section to expose in place. Never point a tunnel at pi-web's own port: the host gate would 403 it unless whitelisted, and whitelisting it would expose pi-web unauthenticated.
en.services.needsAuthHint: Free signup at ngrok.com, then run: ngrok config add-authtoken <token>
en.services.portTunnelHint: Only this port is exposed. Never tunnel pi-web itself without authentication.
en.services.authHint: Add HTTPS and authentication in front of pi-web (or the tunnel) before exposing anything.
en.services.authBuiltinTitle: Built-in (selectable in the port card's “Expose now”)
en.services.authBuiltinPortal: portal — built-in auth portal: user management + TOTP 2FA (manage users in the Users tab)
en.services.authBuiltinBasic: basic — HTTP Basic auth: username + password
en.services.authBuiltinAuthelia: authelia — self-hosted Authelia via forward_auth (unavailable on Windows)
en.services.authExtendTitle: Extendable — configure in front of pi-web / the tunnel (nginx or Caddy)
en.services.authExtendList:
Authentik — open-source identity platform (OIDC/SAML/LDAP)
oauth2-proxy — lightweight reverse-proxy auth via Google/GitHub/OIDC
Keycloak — enterprise IAM (heavier)
Cloudflare Access — managed zero-trust gateway
en.services.configCurrent: This page is served from {host} — {host} virtual hosts are enabled automatically, e.g. http://<port>{host}{pagePort}{basePath}.
en.services.doctorMockHint: Mock mode (library netcheck not implemented yet)
en.services.ddnsEmptyGuide: Add a provider credential, create a profile, then bind registration entries — portmap/tunnel exposes update DNS automatically.
en.services.portIdentityUnavailable: Service identification unavailable in this library version

zh-CN.services.title: 服务端口
zh-CN.services.selfExposeHint: 开启一个带认证的公网入口（portal/basic/authelia）。外部用户只能通过该网关访问 pi-web；直连 127/局域网由下方 allowlocal 开关控制。
zh-CN.services.selfStopTunnelHint: 仅停止该隧道渠道（虚拟主机入口保留）
zh-CN.services.selfStopVhostHint: 停止该虚拟主机通道（移除 binding，隧道入口保留）
zh-CN.services.selfAllowLocalHint: 关闭后，局域网/公网/回环直连本端口一律 403——只有经过认证的网关可用：虚拟主机域名与自暴露隧道域名都会走 proxy 认证；回环（127.0.0.1/localhost）同样受影响（仅例外域名与自暴露的网关认证转发可入）。
zh-CN.services.selfAllowHostsHint: allowlocal=false 时仍允许直连的域名——你自己防护层（反向代理）转发的入口。只认你显式列出的域名（部署域不会自动放行：裸部署域要么走 proxy 认证，要么显式列在这里）。
zh-CN.services.selfGatedHint: allowlocal=false：直连被拒绝（403），请走虚拟主机/隧道认证入口
zh-CN.services.selfNotExposingHint: 当前未暴露 pi-web：allowlocal=false 时本端口直连（含回环）一律 403——先通过下方暴露方法（虚拟主机/隧道）开启入口，外部访问才可达。
zh-CN.services.lockoutTitle: allowlocal 已临时关闭（{ttl} 秒内自动恢复）
zh-CN.services.lockoutCountdown: 本地直连已临时关闭，{ttl} 秒内自动恢复。请确认你仍能访问 pi-web（可打开下方入口验证登录），并在 {window} 秒内点击「确认关闭」永久生效——否则自动回退，不会锁死。
zh-CN.services.lockoutAutoRestore: 不做任何操作 → allowlocal 自动恢复（不会被锁）。
zh-CN.services.lockoutBlockedHint: 直连已被屏蔽（403）：该操作需通过认证入口（虚拟主机/隧道）访问才能完成。等待自动恢复（约 {ttl}s），或使用下面可用的访问方式。
zh-CN.services.lockoutNoEntry: 当前没有任何关闭后仍可访问的入口：pi-web 未暴露（无虚拟主机/隧道），也未配置例外域名（allowHost）。关闭后将无法访问。请先暴露 pi-web（虚拟主机/隧道认证入口）或添加例外域名。
zh-CN.services.selfEnvHint: 永久配置（复制到启动脚本）：
zh-CN.services.selfEnvNote: 界面改动一次性生效，重启恢复环境变量值。如需持久化请设置 PI_WEB_EXPOSE。
zh-CN.services.selfWarning: pi-web 正在暴露且可从非回环地址访问——局域网直连会绕过网关认证。建议仅监听 127.0.0.1 或启用密码。
zh-CN.services.selfNoAuthSummary: 任何拿到地址的人都能完全控制 pi-web（执行命令、读写文件），存在数据泄露风险
zh-CN.services.selfNoAuthBody: pi-web 承载 agent 会话，可执行任意命令、读写用户文件。当前自暴露（expose self）未启用任何网关认证（auth=none）：任何拿到地址的人都能完全控制 pi-web。即使 allowlocal 关闭，开放的虚拟主机/隧道入口依然可经部署域访问。
zh-CN.services.selfNoAuthSuggest: 换成带认证的暴露方法：在「服务 → 暴露 pi-web 自身」把认证从 none 改为 portal / basic（或 authelia），并确保该站点下有可登录用户（可开启 2FA）\n或把模式改为仅 proxy（本地虚拟主机，受 allowlocal / 密码门禁约束），不开启隧道\n或立即停止暴露，之后再重新配置
zh-CN.services.none: 没有发现服务端口。pi 会话启动的服务会自动出现在这里。
zh-CN.services.viaProxy: 通过 pi-web 虚拟主机
zh-CN.services.infoAccess: 如何让其他设备访问（DNS / 泛域名）
zh-CN.services.exposeLocal: 本机：*.pi.localhost 零配置（RFC 6761，浏览器自动映射 127.0.0.1）。
zh-CN.services.exposeLan: 局域网：dnsmasq 加 address=/pi.lan/<服务器IP>，并设置 PI_WEB_SVC_HOST_SUFFIX=.pi.lan、PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS=pi.lan。
zh-CN.services.exposePublic: 公网域名：DNS 加通配 A 记录 *.pi.example.com → 服务器IP，域名加入 PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS。
zh-CN.services.exposeTunnel: 隧道只暴露单个服务端口（或其虚拟主机子域名）——绝不是 pi-web 本体。在服务端口卡片的「公网访问」区选择隧道类型 + 认证方式就地开启。切勿把隧道指向 pi-web 自身端口：未加入白名单会被防护拦截（403），加入则等于无防护暴露 pi-web。
zh-CN.services.portTunnel: 开启此端口隧道（仅暴露该端口）
zh-CN.services.needsAuthHint: ngrok.com 免费注册后执行：ngrok config add-authtoken <token>
zh-CN.services.portTunnelHint: 只暴露该端口。pi-web 本体未经认证防护不要走隧道。
zh-CN.services.authHint: 在暴露任何服务前，请先为 pi-web（或隧道）配置 HTTPS 与认证。
zh-CN.services.authBuiltinTitle: 已内置支持（端口卡片「立即公开」中可直接选用）
zh-CN.services.authBuiltinPortal: portal —— 内置认证门户：自带用户管理与 TOTP 2FA，可在「用户」页签添加/管理用户
zh-CN.services.authBuiltinBasic: basic —— HTTP Basic 认证：用户名 + 密码
zh-CN.services.authBuiltinAuthelia: authelia —— 接入自托管 Authelia（forward_auth；Windows 平台不可用）
zh-CN.services.authExtendTitle: 可自行扩展（在 pi-web / 隧道前置的 nginx 或 Caddy 上配置）
zh-CN.services.authExtendList:
Authentik —— 开源身份平台（OIDC/SAML/LDAP）
oauth2-proxy —— 轻量反向代理认证，对接 Google/GitHub/OIDC
Keycloak —— 企业级 IAM（较重）
Cloudflare Access —— 托管式零信任网关
zh-CN.services.configCurrent: 当前页面通过 {host} 访问，已自动支持 {host} 虚拟主机，地址形如 http://<端口>{host}{pagePort}{basePath}。
zh-CN.services.doctorMockHint: mock 模式（库 netcheck 尚未实现）
zh-CN.services.ddnsEmptyGuide: 先添加 provider 凭据，再建 profile，然后登记注册条目——portmap/tunnel 暴露会自动更新 DNS。
zh-CN.services.portIdentityUnavailable: 当前库版本不支持服务识别
zh-CN.mobile.title: 手机访问
zh-CN.mobile.subtitle: 扫码在手机上打开 pi-web
zh-CN.mobile.firstHint: 首次使用：创建手机登录账号（已创建过可直接用原账号）
zh-CN.mobile.httpsHint: 刷脸需 https（配证书或用隧道）
zh-CN.mobile.qrHint: 手机相机或浏览器扫码打开
zh-CN.mobile.fullSettingsTitle: 服务端口对话框 · Pi-web 页签
zh-CN.mobile.accountExists: 账号已存在，直接用原账号原密码登录
zh-CN.mobile.tierFaceHint: 刷脸为第二因子：本机采集（安全上下文），手机端经 https 验证
zh-CN.mobile.riskConfirmBody: 同一 WiFi 内任何人无需密码即可操作这台机器上的 pi-web。确认继续？
zh-CN.mobile.reason.no-base-domain: 未配置部署域名（PI_WEB_BASE_DOMAIN）；可自行配域名 + nginx 反代
zh-CN.mobile.reason.no-tool: 未安装隧道工具（cloudflared / ngrok / frpc）
zh-CN.mobile.reason.binding-local-only: 服务只监听本机回环，局域网不可达
zh-CN.mobile.reason.no-nonloopback-if: 没有局域网 IPv4 接口
zh-CN.mobile.reason.gateway-no-upnp: 路由器不支持/未开启 UPnP
zh-CN.mobile.facePendingHint: 人脸已登记（待首次验证转正）；先在电脑验证一次
zh-CN.mobile.totpSetup: 用验证器 App 扫码添加
zh-CN.mobile.unsafeBody: 当前只能生成无认证的公网/局域网入口，为防裸奔已禁止出码。两条出路：
zh-CN.mobile.unsafeWay1: 安装 cloudflared 隧道工具（一键公网 + 密码）
zh-CN.mobile.unsafeWay2: 配置部署域名 + nginx 反代（服务虚拟主机 + 密码）
zh-CN.mobile.pickChannel: 已有多条通道，选择一条出码
zh-CN.mobile.rememberedGone: 记住的方案已不可用，已回落推荐方案
zh-CN.mobile.tunnelCloudflaredHint: cloudflared 快速隧道（trycloudflare.com），偶发不通或限速
zh-CN.mobile.pageLoopbackHint: 当前地址是本机回环地址，手机扫码打不开
zh-CN.mobile.pageLanHint: 此地址仅同一局域网内可访问
zh-CN.mobile.setupAccess: 设置随时可访问的入口
zh-CN.mobile.portsEmpty: 还没有已暴露的服务——先在服务端口里暴露一个
zh-CN.mobile.sourceRememberedGone: 上次选择的地址已不可用，已改选第一个
zh-CN.mobile.footerTitle: 手机访问：扫码在手机上打开 pi-web

extensions.description: Cross-project session panel — tag tree + colors / favorites / search / archive / kanban / new-session branch·Worktree picker / history parsing for 23 agent families / DockStack orchestration

features.label: 顶栏会话搜索框
features.description: 顶栏（含 ⋯ 菜单）的会话搜索框；全部会话面板内已有搜索

features.label: 收藏图标
features.description: 会话列表/看板/顶栏显示收藏（★）图标；关闭后收藏操作入口收敛到标签下拉的「收藏」项（标签下拉始终可用）

features.label: 会话行时间线按钮
features.description: 侧栏会话行悬停操作里显示「⎇ 时间线」按钮（aiti-git-trace 打开该会话的变更时间线）；全部会话面板行「⋯」菜单的时间线入口不受此开关影响

features.label: 左栏文件夹区块保留数
features.description: 切换项目时自动打开的文件夹区块数量上限（未钉住的先进先出；钉住的不占配额）。默认 3，可填 1-9，非法值回落 3。在 extman「功能管理」里改。

features.label: 会话检索工具（session_search / session_read）
features.description: 给新建的 pi 会话注入两个只读工具：全文检索本机全部 agent 的历史会话、按会话读原始消息（压缩找回/翻旧账）。关闭后仅新建会话不再获得工具（存量会话在 wrapper 重建前仍持有）。
